claims.claim: Environmental friction is a practical design heuristic: effort, time and interruptions can make a behaviour less convenient. Changing the surroundings may make a desired action easier to start. It does not remove structural constraints such as long work hours or caring duties. Avoid equating convenience with moral virtue; the goal is to reduce unnecessary barriers and preserve choice. A change should be reversible and safe.
